scoring_justification: Band dispersion verified by structural properties (Dirac point gap, linearity, opposite slopes) because exact propagation constants require eigenmode solver; surface existence map recomputed analytically but band dominates weighting.

outputs.description: Dispersion curves for the upper and lower bands, used to verify the Dirac point and band inversion.

Existence map of surface modes as a function of asymmetry parameter eta and surface perturbation Z. The checker recomputes existence flags using the analytic formula as a structural consistency check.

output_contract.notes: The band dispersion step is load-bearing because its hidden reference values depend on the coupling coefficients extracted in the process step. The existence map step uses a structural audit via analytic recompute; no process dependency.

steps.description: Verify Dirac point and band inversion via structural properties: gap at kappa=0, linearity of branches, opposite slopes, matching intercepts.
Recompute existence flags from Eq. (3) for every (eta, Z) pair in the grid and compare row-wise; score = fraction of matching entries.
